name: trustpilot-reviews-scraper
title: Trustpilot Reviews Scraper - Brand Ratings & Replies
description: Research public Trustpilot reviews, ratings, company replies and reply timing for US CX teams and ecommerce agencies. Compare brand samples and export CSV; company TrustScore summaries are stored separately. $1/1,000 saved reviews plus the start fee. No company-check fee or API key.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

review-scraped.eventDescription: Charged for each Trustpilot review successfully extracted and saved to the dataset.
